Hi Kimberly,

We're in the final stages of our vendor selection for the NebulaCorp platform RFP. Procurement has asked us to collect the full SIG questionnaire, a SOC 2 bridge letter (if available), and evidence substantiation for a prioritized control list. Specifically they called out controls around:

- Data encryption in transit and at rest (KMS key proof, config screenshots)
- Privileged access (IAM roles, just-in-time or approval workflows)
- Logging and alerting (sample audit logs, retention policy)
- Change control (release notes, deployment approvals)
- Network segmentation and VPC architecture diagrams

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: the SIG spreadsheet (populated or a mapping template we can use), a SOC 2 bridge letter or attestation, and a recommended list of artifacts per control? Our deadline for the initial package is COB Tuesday, 2027-11-09.

Also let me know your preferred secure upload method (SFTP, secure Drive link, etc.). If there are any controls that require redaction or legal review, flag them early.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so I can update procurement.

Best,
Sarah Johnson

Folks — quick clarifications / recommended format to avoid back-and-forth with Nebula: 

- Evidence formats: prefer PDF (for signed docs), CSV/JSON for logs (include a manifest describing fields), PNG/PDF for architecture diagrams.
- Hashing: for large archives include SHA256 checksums in the manifest so recipients can validate integrity.
- Redaction: Mina — please add which fields were redacted in audit log samples, and include a mapping so Nebula can reconcile sample vs full export.
- Access: we'll create a dedicated SFTP path (sftp://sftp.redwood-inference.com/nebulacorp-uploads) with time-limited credentials. Please avoid emailing credentials — we will hand them off via a secure ticket.
- Attestation: for controls that require sign-off (e.g., encryption key custody), we'll provide a DocuSign envelope. Draft DocuSign link will be generated once artifacts are staged.
